{{Quote|The losses of our brothers from the 442nd Siege Battalion on Hypori were particularly painful.|[[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Neyo]]|<ref name="OSWM 121">{{GermanFanCite|121|Database}}</ref>}}
'''Hypori''' was a remote [[planet]]<ref name="BMF 63">{{BuildFalconCite|63|Starship Fact File}}</ref> located in the [[Hypori system]] in the [[Ferra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that had a hydrothermal landscape that was host to a [[Techno Union]] [[Baktoid Armor Workshop|droid factory]]. The hulk of a crashed [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class transgalactic military assault ship]] stood as a grim memorial of a [[Battle of Hypori|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars]] in which a group of [[Jedi Knight]]s were taken by surprise.<ref name="Catalyst" /> Hypori had a [[Geonosian]] colony, and [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)|Geonosian warriors]] protected Baktoid Armor factories on the planet.<ref name="OSWM 122" /> During the [[Imperial Era]], [[Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic's]] engineering team was based at an [[Hypori Imperial research station|Imperial facility]] on the planet where they worked in weapon development for the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[18 BBY]], the research station was destroyed by [[Star Destroyer]] [[turbolaser]]s.<ref name="Catalyst" /> At some point, [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] ordered for the [[Cosinga-class Heavy Corvette|''Cosinga''-class Heavy Corvette]] ''[[Imperialis]]'' to be constructed over Hypori. [[Engine]]s sourced from the [[Sedapard Cluster]] were brought to Hypori for the construction project.<ref name="BMF 63" /> In the last [[Standard week|weeks]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]], [[TK-4610]] and his [[TK-4610's unit|Imperial unit]] was forced to leave Hypori. Rather than be captured like the rest of his unit, TK-4610 retreated to the planet [[Nevarro]].<ref name="TMVG">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Visual Guide]]''</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 63|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 63]] incorrectly states that Hypori is located along the [[Corellian Run]], contradicting all known map placements of Hypori in both [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] and [[canon]] material.<ref name="BMF 63" />
